criterion_text: Linux independent per-Pane cgroup discovery lists current descendants, including reparented workers, with deduplication across linked tmux Windows and bounded enumeration.

verifiers.summary: Linux dedicated per-Pane cgroup discovery is verified, including recursive membership, shared-scope rejection, linked-Window deduplication and bounded enumeration

evidence.value: exact SHA bedaa172a59c716e04398a5d2ce98c4da1659e97 on Linux x86_64: a tmux-spawn scope was resolved under the cgroup root, nested cgroup.procs were read recursively, and the Pane root had to be present before membership was claimed
a cgroup containing the Agent was rejected as shared; linked Window rows kept both Session memberships while the Pane and its process list appeared once; process and depth bounds marked truncation
a real isolated tmux server reported its Pane root and descendants through the same snapshot projection, under the discovery method the runner actually exposes
